{{Article header|deck=Physical performance specialist at The Divine Apparatus in the Deriso system.}}

{{Draft warning}}

{{Engineer infobox}}

Baltanos specialises in physical performance modifications for suits and handheld weapons.<ref name="inara-list" />

Odyssey Engineering is a separate system from ship Engineering — it modifies suits and handheld weapons rather than ship modules, and exists only in Live (there is no Legacy equivalent). See [[Engineers]] for how the two systems are organised.

== Location ==
* '''System:''' Deriso
* '''Settlement:''' The Divine Apparatus
* '''Region:''' Colonia

== How to Discover This Engineer ==
Baltanos is independently available and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-list">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara.</ref>

== How to Receive an Invitation ==
There is no separate invitation requirement distinct from the unlock requirement below.

== How to Unlock This Engineer ==
Unlock requirements summary:
* Reach '''Friendly''' reputation with the '''Colonia Council'''.

For the complete step-by-step process, see [[Unlocking Baltanos]].

== Engineer Unlock Chain ==
Baltanos is one of three independent Colonia Odyssey Engineers (alongside [[Eleanor Bresa]] and [[Rosa Dayette]]) whose referral tasks all feed into [[Yi Shen]].<ref name="inara-list" />

After Baltanos is unlocked, delivering '''10 Faction Associates''' data completes the referral task toward Yi Shen. All three Colonia Engineers' referral tasks must be completed before Yi Shen becomes available.

== Available Engineering ==
Specific suit/weapon modification names and maximum grades were not confirmed in the sources checked for this pass — see [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Engineering Architecture]] for the site's policy on not inventing unconfirmed specifics. Confirmed specialty area: Physical performance.

== Experimental Effects ==
To be added — not confirmed in the sources checked for this pass.

== Increasing Engineer Reputation ==
Reputation increases through crafting modifications at their workshop, in line with the general mechanic covered on the main [[Engineering]] page.

== Blueprint Pinning ==
'''Fact:''' Baltanos's confirmed specialty area is Physical performance.

'''EDFM recommendation:''' Not yet made. A pinning recommendation needs the specific modification and maximum-grade data above filled in first — see [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Engineering Architecture]] for why EDFM treats pinning guidance as editorial judgement, not a database fact.

== Related Engineers ==
[[Eleanor Bresa]] and [[Rosa Dayette]] are the other two independent Colonia Odyssey Engineers whose referral tasks converge on [[Yi Shen]].
